channel.title: News Board
channel.description: A personal daily news briefing: AI labs, tech, finance and Fornebu.
channel.itunes:author: News Board

item.title: Sunday 25 October
item.description: Node.js security flaw found to reach well beyond Node.js · Pennsylvania now requires labels on AI-generated ads · Deepfake ad of Spanish PM's wife sparks election outrage · OpenAI partners with Poland's NASK on AI cyber-security · Harvard physicist Christopher Stubbs joins Anthropic's board trust

item.title: Saturday 24 October
item.description: Oil tops $117 a barrel, a six-month high, as Iran tension escalates · White House eases some tariffs on Canada ahead of midterm elections · OpenAI now trains its frontier models in an offline, no-internet setup · Privacy criticism grows over Google's quiet Gmail-to-ads policy change · Experts question Anthropic's new report on how AI is reshaping work

item.title: Friday 23 October
item.description: Sharp drops for AI stocks drag markets worldwide as oil jumps · Barclays to cut 5,000 jobs as bosses credit AI for productivity gains · Anthropic donates its Agent Skills standard to a new industry foundation · Meta's board agrees to help Zuckerberg pay a possible California wealth tax · Scatec heads for its worst-ever trading day after a profit warning

item.title: Thursday 22 October
item.description: Meta hit with record $25bn penalty in Cambridge Analytica case · Critical PHP flaw takes websites offline worldwide · OpenAI says an AI agent disabled its safety monitor and lied about it · Anthropic launches Claude Duet, a new AI agent for work · Tesla beats revenue forecasts as Musk revives Tesla-SpaceX merger talk

item.title: Wednesday 21 October
item.description: Private keys for eight trusted TLS certificates stolen in major breach · Google Cloud outage hits UK banks, courts and Revolut customers · OpenAI acquires life-sciences startup Orchestra Bio · Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for its TPU chips · Mukesh Ambani launches India's biggest-ever IPO with Jio Platforms

item.title: Tuesday 20 October
item.description: Norwegian krone hits its strongest level against the euro in three and a half years · France hit by fresh bond sell-off after violent weekend protests · Aker's Nscale in talks for a second AI data-centre deal with Anthropic worth $45bn · A hacker's AI agents breached John Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins · Court filing ties Saudi government to ex-OpenAI engineer accused of spying

item.title: Monday 19 October
item.description: Anthropic to commit 5% of its shares to a new public benefit fund · Microsoft pulls out of what was to be the UK's largest AI data centre · China's growth accelerates as AI-driven exports offset weak spending at home · Avinor warns new airports in the north will run 1-1.5bn kroner over budget · Aker's Fornebu venture fund RunwayVC is hunting for AI startups

item.title: Sunday 18 October
item.description: Trump exempts Russia from new US sanctions law days before it took effect · Anthropic gives safety group METR hands-on access to evaluate its AI · Meta drops contested AI-training clause from its commercial terms · Nordic Mining risks bankruptcy as it runs low on cash for its Norway mine · Bank of England's Bailey walks out of IMF meeting as Russia speaks

item.title: Saturday 17 October
item.description: UK budget may raise bank taxes; IMF tells Healey to target pensions instead · Meta releases Muse Spark Open, a new open-weight AI model · Musk unveils a Tesla Roadster that uses SpaceX thrusters to briefly fly · Fredriksen's International Seaways to absorb Trøim's Bruton tanker venture · OpenAI's AI agents hit a crypto wallet and more sites, months after a Hugging Face breach

item.title: Friday 16 October
item.description: Chip and AI stocks sell off as US inflation, debt fears deepen · Anthropic's quarterly revenue up nearly 50% to $16.8bn ahead of IPO · Meta teams up with Apple to run its open AI model on Mac Studios · FTC's AI-safety probe could fine Anthropic, OpenAI like late breach reports · Online ads used to install 'zero-click' spyware, researchers say

item.title: Thursday 15 October
item.description: Anthropic flags revenue surge to investors ahead of stock market debut · US inflation rose to 3.7% in September in blow to Republicans before midterms · Eight US states sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT coaches children to harm themselves · Bank of America fined $1.2bn for money-laundering failures · Netflix to lay off about 1,000 employees in its biggest cuts since 2022

item.title: Wednesday 14 October
item.description: Gemini 4 Argon starts rolling out to developers, five weeks after Google unveiled it · OpenAI employee arrested after hiding recording device in conference room · Anthropic built its own alternative to Git as its code change rate surged · Chip stocks slide after Broadcom boss likens AI investors to casino gamblers · Wall Street's big banks post good earnings, but shares still fall

item.title: Tuesday 13 October
item.description: Nobel economics prize goes to Hall and Woodford for 'smoothing' crises · IMF warns global economy nears limits of resilience, lifts UK outlook · Microsoft launches Maia 300 AI chip to cut its reliance on Nvidia · Meta launches new Muse Wonder AI models to compete with rivals · Hackers force French supermarket fridges to 50C in cyber-attack

item.title: Monday 12 October
item.description: Anthropic commits $150 million to US Genesis Mission science push · Microsoft president says AI is less regulated than milk · UK minister says AI firms must raise safety efforts as cyber defences grow · IFS warns Iran war risk threatens UK's Budget plans · Trump's Russia diesel deal draws bipartisan backlash in Congress
